market_positions.segment_name: AWS · marché IT mondial adressable (cloud + on-premises en migration)
market_positions.source: Adam Selipsky, CEO AWS, keynote re:Invent 2022 (29 nov 2022) : repris ensuite par Andy Jassy aux earnings calls Q4 2023 et Q4 2024
market_positions.source_note: Adam Selipsky chiffre le global IT market à 'well over $3 trillion' lors de son keynote re:Invent 2022 et positionne AWS comme la plateforme de migration de ce marché vers le cloud. Andy Jassy reprend la thèse aux earnings calls Q4 2023 (1 fév 2024) et Q4 2024 (6 fév 2025) en martelant que ~85-90 % du IT spend mondial est encore on-premises, donc le runway de migration vers AWS est encore largement devant. Borne unique 3 000 Mds $ retenue car Amazon n'a jamais publié de fourchette officielle. AWS Net Sales FY2024 = 107,6 Mds $ (10-K AMZN déposé 7 fév 2025), soit ~3,6 % du TAM IT mondial chiffré par Selipsky : marge de pénétration énorme côté Amazon. Méthodologie : disclosure top-down direction AWS, pas de tiers (Gartner / IDC) cité ici car Mettrik n'utilise que les chiffres énoncés par la société elle-même.

company_description: Amazon.com, Inc. engages in the retail sale of consumer products, advertising, and subscriptions service through online and physical stores in North America and internationally. The company operates through three segments: North America, International, and Amazon Web Services (AWS). It also manufactures and sells electronic devices, including Kindle, fire tablets, fire TVs, echo, ring, blink, and eero; and develops and produces media content. In addition, the company offers programs that enable sellers to sell their products in its stores; and programs that allow authors, independent publishers, musicians, filmmakers, Twitch streamers, skill and app developers, and others to publish and sell content. Further, it provides compute, storage, Artificial intelligence, database, analytics, machine learning, and other services, as well as advertising services through programs, such as sponsored ads, display, and video advertising. Additionally, the company offers Amazon Prime, a membership program.
